papers.summary: Overall extraction quality is high. The main pathogenic mutations (c.207+196T>A, c.1811+326C>T, p.*917Rext*83) are accurately captured with correct UDS values matching Table 1. Hypomorphic and refuted mutations are properly contextualized. Minor issues include perturbation_type classification for stop-loss variant and consistent index_system naming inconsistencies flagged in validation errors.

supported_points: All 15 UDS % values match Table 1 exactly (XP136KO:13%, XP37NG:21%, XP43NG:21%, etc.)
Mechanism (aberrant splicing, 192bp intron retention, NMD) accurately described per Docs 24-26
Mutation notation c.207+196T>A correctly extracted from Table 1 and text
Patient genotypes (homozygous vs heterozygous) correctly identified from Table 1
problems: Index system inconsistency flagged: primary_index_system='author_defined' but sequence_target uses 'cDNA'

supported_points: UDS values for XP2YO (4%) and XP3YO (9%) match Table 1 Continued

problems: Index system inconsistency flagged: primary_index_system='author_defined' but sequence_target uses 'cDNA'
